title: Integral lattices assemble on finite disjoint unions
statement: Let ell be prime, E a normed field extension of Q_ell, X a scheme, P any internal continuous rational module, I a finite type, Y_i a family of schemes, and p_i:Y_i→X arbitrary maps. Suppose each Y_i is supplied with an internal integral module M_i, a pro-etale finite free trivializing cover, and an isomorphism E tensor M_i ≅ p_i*P, using the coefficient objects of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Then there exists an internal integral module N on the scheme coproduct of the Y_i, with a pro-etale finite free trivializing cover and an isomorphism E tensor N ≅ (Sigma.desc p)*P. The statement includes an empty family and zero ranks; it requires no compatibility of the M_i, no noetherianity, no etale condition and no local freeness of P.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, finite affine cover step; explicit extension-by-zero proof of disjoint-union assembly (Stacks Project Tag 04TR)

proof.text: Construct N as the finite biproduct of extensions by zero j_i! M_i along the component inclusions. For different components j_i* j_t* Q is zero since its sections lie over empty pullbacks. Adjunction twice therefore proves j_t* j_i! M_i is zero. For equal components the open-extension unit is an isomorphism by full faithfulness. The pulled-back biproduct inclusion is consequently an isomorphism, with inverse the projection, giving j_t*N ≅ M_t. Use the existing public full_openImmersionLowerShriek and faithful_openImmersionLowerShriek instances for condensed module objects from WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.ProEtale.ModuleObject.Derived.OpenImmersionEssImage. These lift the fixed-coefficient extension-by-zero full faithfulness through Adjunction.fullyFaithfulMapModLeft and the coefficient comap equivalence. The generic Adjunction.unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful then makes the module adjunction unit invertible. No recollement theorem or private recollement helper is needed.

Transport the supplied free cover of each M_t to the raw pullback of N by restriction along the invertible condensedPullbackHom. Bind those covers with the component cover. The raw pullback composition isomorphism and the mapMod comparison prove finite freeness on the bound cover, with exactly the predicate required by the statement. Reuse the shared ContinuousLocallyFreePullback API instead of redeclaring its helpers. The raw composition helper is imported from CondensedFieldLfpLocalTriviality.

Extension of scalars preserves the finite biproduct and commutes with open extension by zero by openImmersionShriekIso. Apply the supplied rationalization isomorphisms and the pullback composition comparison to obtain the biproduct of j_i! j_i* Q, where Q=(Sigma.desc p)*P. Its counit map to Q becomes an isomorphism on every component by the adjunction triangle identity. The underlying abelian restriction functors are conservative on an open cover; the module forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, so this counit is an isomorphism globally. The empty family follows by the same conservativity argument.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousLattice_finite_coproduct
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    {I : Type u} [Finite I] (Y : I → Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X)
    (M : ∀ i, Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Y i)) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (Y i)))
    (hM : ∀ i, ∃ D : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage (Y i), ∀ s : D.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).obj
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (Y i)))
        (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).mapMod _).obj (M i)))
    (e : ∀ i, Nonempty
      ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (Y i))).obj (M i) ≅
        (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) (p i)).obj P)) :
    ∃ M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (∐ Y)) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (∐ Y)),
      (∃ D : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage (∐ Y), ∀ s : D.I₀,
        Mod.IsFree ((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).obj
          (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) (∐ Y)))
          (((ProEtale.upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (D.f s)).mapMod _).obj M)) ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) (∐ Y))).obj M ≅
        (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) (Sigma.desc p)).obj P)
